verdict.rationale: The pack contains no evidence that Kling's built-in Agent can connect to external MCP servers to use their tools. The only MCP mention ('Let Your Agent Power Kling') describes the opposite role: an external agent driving Kling through MCP/CLI. That is server-side and does not count for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
